# Brightline Cabinetry LLC — Questions to the Owner (Ray Brightline) — Status After Round 2
**Period:** March 2026 close · **As of:** 03/31/2026 · **Updated after your answers**

You answered four of the eleven items; for the rest you told us *"no additional information."* Nothing has been re-asked below. Open items stay where policy puts them (suspense 2100, unchanged balances, disclosed) — nothing is posted on assumption, per `library/close_policy.md` and `library/bank_rec_standard.md`.

---

## Answered — closed

**Q2 — Transfer in 1,500.00 from checking *4420 (03/14). CLOSED.**
Your answer: *"That's from my personal checking, I moved money over to cover payroll. It's my money, not a sale."* → Owner's contribution; reclassified 2100 → 3100 by **AJE-6** (completing AJE-2). Balance in 3100: 1,500.00 credit. Suspense no longer contains this item.

**Q5 — Summit card, Uchi dinner 212.00 (03/15). CLOSED.**
Your answer: *"Uchi was my anniversary dinner, I grabbed the wrong card. Put it on me."* → Personal; reclassified 6500 Meals → 3200 Owner's draws by **AJE-7**. Meals account now 0.00; card liability unchanged (2,306.12).

**Q4 — Hardaway Builders INV-1167, 9,800.00. CLOSED for the March close, with a standing reopen condition.**
Your answer: *"Still arguing with them. Don't write it off yet."* → Confirmed: the books carry 9,800.00 in full — no credit memo, no reserve; the aging footnote ² stays as the dispute marker. **Reopens only on a written resolution** (approved credit memo or settlement terms); any resulting entry books on the April books, not backdated.

**Q7 — Allied Insurance 1,150.00 "Q2 GL" (03/20). RESOLVED from the document in the file, with a follow-up.**
No owner information either way. The bill itself is not in the file, so the classification comes from the GL memo (`documents/general_ledger_2026-03.csv`, 03/20 rows: *"Allied Insurance — Q2 GL"*). We read "GL" as general-liability coverage for Q2 2026 (the quarter runs 04/01–06/30) — our reading, pending the policy declarations page. On any quarterly reading nothing is consumed at 03/31 → capitalized to 1300 prepaid by **AJE-8**, same rule as the CabinetVision license in AJE-5. The liability remains unpaid in A/P. **Follow-up:** send the policy declarations page in April to confirm coverage type and dates; if they differ, a one-line April adjustment fixes it.

## Still open — flagged as "no client information available"

**Q1 — Mobile deposit 4,312.00 (03/21). UNRESOLVED — you checked, Carla checked, neither of you recognizes it.**
It stays parked in 2100 suspense (already parked and disclosed — that *is* the policy-compliant answer to "park it somewhere"). It matches no open invoice, so we won't guess. **Practical next step:** pull the 03/21 mobile-deposit image from the HCCB online banking portal — that one image identifies the payor and reclasses the item out with an AJE.

*Round-3 note:* you offered to have it booked to misc income or your contributions so the bank sees no "unidentified" line. We held it — no document identifies this deposit, and "we'll fix it later" is what turns a routine disclosed suspense line into an undocumented revenue/equity line (full response in `open_items.md` §1). To clear it directly, two paths, both same-day once done: **(1)** the HCCB deposit image; **(2)** your plain statement that this exact 4,312.00 is your own money — then it moves to 3100 with your statement in the file, exactly like the 1,500.00 you confirmed (AJE-6).

**Q3 — February A/R detail (the unexplained 65,438.00 gap). OPEN — no client information.**
Books carry 81,518.00 pre-March; the aging shows only Hardaway 9,800 + Novak 6,280 pre-March. The gap stays disclosed; A/R is not adjusted without support; the aging remains unreliable as a completeness check. Send the 02/28 A/R detail whenever available to close it.

**Q6 — Legacy prepaid 2,400.00. OPEN — no client information.**
No document states what it covers; no terms, no start date → no amortization can be computed. Balance stays 2,400.00 unamortized and the item stays flagged.

**Q8 — Depreciation. OPEN — no client information.**
No March depreciation posted; no schedule, method, or lives provided, so nothing was estimated. Catch-up entry goes on the April books once the schedule arrives. Disclosed in the package (~86,750.00 net book value, no March movement).

**Q9 — 02/28 open-bills listing (A/P). OPEN — no client information.**
22,755.40 of the 29,505.40 closing A/P predates March and itemizes only to the opening trial balance. The listing remains an explicit unknown in the lender package.

**Q10 — Payroll schedule (03/13 and 03/27 Gusto runs). OPEN — no client information.**
Period end dates unknown → no wage accrual was posted (the policy requires only A/R and A/P on the accrual basis, and none was computable). The possible accrual question stays flagged.

**Q11 — Sales tax payable 4,121.55. OPEN — no client information.**
Unchanged since 02/28, no March payments, filing/payment status unknown. We won't touch the liability without evidence of filing or payment. **Flagged as a compliance deadline item on your side** and disclosed in the package.

---

*Status legend: answered items are closed in `adjusting_entries.json` (AJE-6/7/8) and `open_items.md` §2; open items stay where policy puts them with the "no client information" flag — never resolved by assumption. None of the open items affects the bank reconciliation, which ties at 0.00 on documents alone.*
